facts.fact: 7月3日 David 在 CVS 上双班（double shift），临近下班时突发食物中毒、疑因吃了坏的 baked ziti；当夜和次日大半天他都在家里剧烈腹泻。
facts.anchor: On July 3, David worked a double shift at CVS, near the end of which he came down with a sudden bout of food poisoning presumably caused by some bad baked ziti.

facts.fact: 7月4日傍晚 David 病情好转，与父母坐在火车站毯子上看全镇年度独立日烟花（Hudson River 上空），Erin 和她妈妈在公园另一侧自己的毯子上观看；散场后两家人在停车场相遇寒暄（Erin 和 David 只是拥抱问好没多谈），David 的妈妈对 Erin 的妈妈 Mary 说 “He was sick as a dog…The bathroom was a radioactive zone.”
facts.anchor: “He was sick as a dog,” David’s mom told Mary. “The bathroom was a radioactive zone.”

facts.fact: 7月5日 David 借了母亲的 Volvo，约下午五点到 Erin 家接她，开车抵达 Troy 的 Majestic Diner（off Route 4）时天已全黑并开始下雨。
facts.anchor: On July 5, David borrowed his mom’s Volvo and picked Erin up from her house around five p.m.

facts.fact: 路上 David 第六或第七遍复述当晚的“游戏计划”：若 Jim 真来就听他说完，但始终待在他人视线内、去洗手间必须结伴、不点任何容易被下 roofie 的东西、只透露 first names。
facts.anchor: “If he shows up—and that’s a big if—we hear what he has to say,” David said for the sixth or seventh time that night.

facts.fact: 进店后 Jim Davis 果然坐在最角落的卡座——正是 David 从 Google Image Search 认熟的那张脸；他起身迎接、点了 disco fries 并分给两人，体型比网上照片更大，体重恐怕超过两个少年之和。
facts.anchor: When David and Erin entered the Majestic, the very same man whose face David now knew well from Google Image Search was sitting at a booth in the far corner. Jim Davis himself, in the flesh.

facts.fact: Jim 的第一个问题是两人谁先看到广播；Erin 立刻答 “I did”，Jim 说一见表情就知道了——“You’re the special one…you’re the one it wants”，称 Public Access Afterworld 正在邀请 Erin “inside”，而 inside 指的是 the video store。
facts.anchor: Jim didn’t take his eyes off Erin. “What I mean is…you’re the one it wants. You’re the one Public Access Afterworld is inviting inside.”

facts.fact: David 点了咖啡，Erin 点了 vodka cranberry（老年侍者没查她证）；此后三十分钟 Erin 又喝了两杯，Jim 讲出整套神话：电视屏幕是维系现实的跨维度系统的一环，某些 special people 能 “through the screen” 抛下肉体、以精神创造地球上的电视节目，而 Erin 命定要进入 Public Access Afterworld、成为 “something more like a god”、字面意义上变成一部电视剧（David 只听懂约三分之一）。
facts.anchor: There were certain special people with special abilities, Jim explained, who could literally travel “through the screen,” who could leave their bodies behind and cosmically prime the broadcast pumps, so to speak, by psychically creating the TV shows we see on our screens back on earth.

facts.fact: Jim 提出若不信可去他家看 demonstration（他有 necessary equipment、离得不远）；David 拒绝并威胁 “We could call your principal right now”，起身要走时还脱口承认自己从未真正相信（“I can’t feel shit”）；Erin 却说 “I don’t care…I’m going there either way, so you better just come with me”——此时她手里已握着第四杯 vodka cranberry。
facts.anchor: “If you don’t believe me,” Jim said, “I can show you. There’s a demonstration. I have the necessary equipment at my house. That’s why I suggested we meet there. I can still show you. It’s not far away.”
